info.title: Attome XRM API
info.description: The Attome XRM platform's HTTP API. Entity record shapes under `/api/v1/{entity}` are resolved from each deployment's runtime metadata (D-003) and therefore cannot be enumerated statically — those operations document the generic envelope only. Fetch `GET /api/v1/schema/{logicalname}` for a live entity's fields.

post.description: Allocates the account's unallocated credit to its open invoices. Audited.

200.description: What each payment's credit paid

409.description: Another payment for the account is being recorded

get.description:
The account's credit limit, whether it is on credit hold, its open balance, and whether an amount
would still fit, as order confirmation checks it.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description:
An amount about to be sold on credit, to check with the open
balance (default 0).

200.description: The credit limit, open balance, hold and whether the amount may be sold on credit

403.description: Caller may not read payments or accounts

404.description: No such account, or not one the caller can read

422.description: amount is not a non-negative number

get.description:
The account's issued documents, payments and write-offs over a period (this month by default), each
with what it adds to the balance; drafts, void and pro forma invoices do not count.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the period (default: the first of this month).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the period (default: today).

200.description: Opening balance, the period's documents and payments, closing balance, per currency

404.description: No such account, or not one the caller can read

422.description: from is after to

get.description: Each account's open balance by how overdue it is, as of a date.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The day the ageing is taken on (default today).

200.description: Open amounts per account and currency by days past due

403.description: Caller may not read invoices or accounts

get.description: The open balance across accounts by how overdue it is, as of a date.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The day the ageing is taken on (default today).

200.description: The ageing of every readable account, per currency (a handful of rows)

403.description: Caller may not read invoices or accounts

get.description:
The evidence a chargeback a gateway reported can draw on, for a person to submit before the
deadline; nothing is submitted automatically.

200.description: The documents that can answer it (page 1 holds them all)

404.description: No such dispute in the caller's scope

post.description:
Where a payment gateway posts its events, with no session: the call is verified with the system's
webhook secret, each event is stored once and a job applies it to its payment. Rate limited per
address.

requestBody.description: The gateway's notification, as it sends it

200.description: Verified and stored; applied by a job

401.description: The signature or secret does not verify

404.description: No such gateway, or billing is not licensed

422.description: A verified notification that does not read

429.description: Too many calls from this address

x-audit-exempt.note: unauthenticated gateway callback; the applied payment change is audited by the job

post.description:
Other features (a won order, a subscription charge, a project milestone) ask for invoices rather
than write them; a request is stored once per source. Holders of `billing.issue`. Audited.

200.description: The stored request (a repeat answers the first)

403.description: Caller may not ask for invoices

422.description: A missing key, an unknown account, a bad currency or line

post.summary: Apply a deposit to a final invoice
post.description:
Adds one negative line per VAT category of an issued deposit invoice to a draft final invoice. A
deposit applies once; a second application is 409. Audited.

200.description: The deposit is deducted and the draft repriced

409.description: Not a final draft, the deposit is not issued, or it is already deducted

422.description: Not a deposit, or another account or currency

post.description:
Issues a credit note for whatever is still uncredited, at once and with a reason; the issue
approval threshold applies to it as to any document. Needs the billing credit privilege. Audited.

200.description: The full credit note, issued or waiting for an approval

409.description: Not issued, already fully credited, or the series is being issued

422.description: No reason

post.description:
Copies a pro forma invoice and its lines into a new draft invoice, which is then priced and issued
as usual; the pro forma stays as it was. Needs the invoice create privilege. Audited.

200.description: The new draft invoice

post.description:
A draft credit note copying chosen lines of the issued invoice with a negative quantity, with a
reason; a line is never credited beyond what earlier credit notes left. An issued invoice itself
never changes. Needs the billing credit privilege. Audited.

200.description: The draft credit note

409.description: The invoice is not issued, or is itself a credit note

422.description: No reason, an unknown line, or more than is left on a line

post.summary: Charge more on an issued invoice
post.description:
A draft debit note with new positive lines for a charge the invoice missed, with a reason. Needs
the billing credit privilege. Audited.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The issued invoice the charge belongs to

200.description: The draft debit note

409.description: The invoice is not issued, or is a credit note

422.description: No reason, no lines, or a line without a positive quantity

get.description:
The ZATCA e-invoice made when the invoice was issued: its status (pending, cleared, reported or
rejected), ZATCA's validation results and the QR code.

200.description: The invoice's e-invoice: status, ZATCA's validation results and the QR code

post.description:
Recomputes a draft's totals and issues it with the next number of its series; it needs an account
and a line, and a pro forma never takes a number (409). Above `billing.issue_approval_threshold`
it opens an approval instead. With e-invoicing on, the e-invoice is made and sent in the same step.
Needs the billing issue privilege. Audited.

200.description: Issued with its number, or waiting for an approval

409.description: Not a draft, pro forma, or the series is being issued

422.description: No account, no lines, or no VAT rate

post.description:
Prices each line through the tax engine and stores the invoice totals summed from the rounded
lines; only a draft (409 otherwise). Needs update rights on invoices. Audited.

200.description: The draft's lines and totals, recomputed

409.description: The invoice is not a draft, or a line changed meanwhile

422.description: No VAT rate applies to a line

post.description:
Writes off up to what is open on an issued invoice, with a reason. Above
`billing.write_off_approval_threshold` it waits for approval. Needs the write-off privilege.
Audited.

200.description: Written off, or waiting for an approval

403.description: Caller may not write off balances

422.description: No reason, or an amount above what is open

get.description:
Monthly recurring revenue per account and currency on a day (today by default), from the nightly
snapshots, and its movement over the days before (30 by default): new, expansion, contraction and
churn.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The day to read (`YYYY-MM-DD`); today when absent.

parameters.name: period_days
parameters.description: Days back for the movements; 30 when absent.

200.description: MRR, ARR and their movements per currency, from the stored snapshots

422.description: period_days is 0 or above 366

post.description:
A single-use link for an issued invoice's open amount, an order's total, or a free amount for an
account, valid 72 hours by default. Holders of `payment_link.create`. Audited.

200.description: The link, shown once

403.description: Caller may not create payment links

404.description: No such invoice, order or account in the caller's scope

422.description: Not one target, not payable, or a bad amount, currency or expiry

post.description:
A manual payment from an account, allocated to its invoices, in one transaction under the account's
balance lock so two payments never allocate the same open amount. Audited.

200.description: The payment and how it was allocated

409.description: Another payment for the account is being recorded

422.description: A bad amount, currency, method or allocation

post.description:
Refunds part or all of a paid payment, never more than earlier refunds left, under the payment's
refund lock. Holders of `payment.refund`. Audited.

200.description: The refund, pending or waiting for an approval

409.description: Not a paid payment, or another refund of it is being recorded

422.description: No reason, or more than is left to refund

post.description: Reverses a payment and its allocations, so the invoices it paid are open again. Audited.

200.description: Reversed; its invoices reopened

409.description: Already reversed, or the account is busy

422.description: No reason

post.description:
Requests an invoice from invoicing for each account, billing period and
currency with planned charges due by `as_of`, in a background job; the
charges become requested. A run that stops carries on where it stopped.

403.description: Caller may not request invoices for subscription charges

post.description:
Lists, per account, billing period and currency, the planned charges a
run on `as_of` would request from invoicing. Writes nothing.

200.description: The invoice requests a run would make

403.description: Caller may not read subscription charges

post.description:
By hand from `lines`, or from an accepted quote (`quote_id`), whose lines
are copied. Each line starts with one dated segment.

404.description: No such quote the caller may read

422.description: Invalid terms or lines, or a quote not accepted

get.summary: Reads a subscription as of a date.
get.description:
The subscription as the caller may read it, with each line's quantity
and price in force on `as_of` (today when absent).

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The day to read the subscription as of (`YYYY-MM-DD`); today when absent.

200.description: The subscription as of the date

403.description: Caller may not read subscription lines

404.description: No such subscription the caller may read

post.summary: Amends a subscription from a date.
post.description:
Each changed line's segment in force on `effective` closes and the next
opens; the rest of that billing period is prorated as a planned charge
or credit. Changing a price needs `subscription.amend_price`.

200.description: The amendment is made

403.description: Caller may not amend, or not change prices

409.description: Another change to this subscription is in progress

422.description: No change, a line with no segment then, or a closed subscription

post.description:
Voids the amendment's segments, lets the segments it closed run on and
cancels its planned charges. Once any part is invoiced it cannot be
reversed; amend again instead.

200.description: The amendment is reversed

404.description: No such amendment of this subscription

409.description: Part of the amendment is invoiced, or another change is in progress

post.description:
At the end of its term, or on a date: the lines end then. Needs
`subscription.cancel`.

200.description: The subscription is cancelled

409.description: Another change to this subscription is in progress

422.description: No date, no term end, or a date before the start

post.description:
From a date, until `resume_on` when given: the lines bill nothing while
paused.

200.description: The subscription is paused

409.description: Another change to this subscription is in progress

422.description: Not active, or a resume before the pause

post.description: On a date: each line bills at its quantity before the pause again.

200.description: The subscription is active again

409.description: Another change to this subscription is in progress

422.description: The subscription is not paused

post.description:
Takes a batch of usage records; each carries the sender's idempotency key, and one already stored
for the same line and time is counted as a duplicate, so a whole batch can be retried.

200.description: Stored; repeated idempotency keys counted as duplicates

422.description: Empty batch, more than 1000 records, or an invalid record

get.description: The e-invoicing units (ZATCA devices) and whether each is onboarded. Holders of `einvoice.manage`.

200.description: Every e-invoicing device (a handful), newest first

post.description:
A ZATCA e-invoicing unit, to be onboarded before it can sign invoices. Holders of
`einvoice.manage`. Audited.

200.description: The new device, with its key and certificate request

409.description: A device with this name exists

422.description: E-invoicing is off, the seller settings are incomplete, or a field is wrong

post.description:
Onboards the device with ZATCA using the one-time password the Fatoora portal shows, so it can
stamp invoices. Holders of `einvoice.manage`. Audited.

200.description: Onboarded: the device holds its production CSID

409.description: The device is onboarded already, or changed meanwhile

422.description: A bad OTP, or ZATCA refused a step (the reason is kept on the device)

get.description: The hosted payment page's view of a link. No session; the token is the credential.

200.description: What the payer is asked to pay

404.description: No live link (unknown, wrong, expired, used or cancelled)

429.description: Too many calls from this address

post.description: Starts the gateway checkout for the link's amount. No session; the token is the credential.

200.description: The checkout to send the payer to

404.description: No live link (unknown, wrong, expired, used or cancelled)

422.description: No gateway takes this payment, or the gateway refused it

429.description: Too many calls from this address

503.description: The gateway could not be reached

x-audit-exempt.note: public payer action; payment audited on success

AllocationRequest.description: One allocation the payer asked for.

at_term_end.description: Cancel at the end of the term instead of on `on`.

order_id.description: From an order (refused until order lines carry a line type).

quote_id.description: Copies an accepted quote's lines instead of `lines`.

as_of.description: Charges due by this day (`YYYY-MM-DD`); today when absent.

method.description: The method the payer chose; card by default.

redirect_url.description: Send the payer here (a hosted page)...

CreditApplied.description:
What applying an account's unapplied credit did: one entry per payment
whose credit paid something.

currency.description: The open invoices' currency; none when there are none.

limit.description: The account's limit; none means no limit.

open_balance.description: What the account owes on its open invoices.

CreditLine.description: One original line to credit, and how much of it.

quantity.description: A positive quantity, at most what is still uncredited on the line.

CurrencyStatement.description: A statement's section in one currency.

DebitLine.description: A new line on a debit note.

DepositApplied.description: The final invoice after a deposit was deducted.

lines.description: Lines added, one per VAT category of the deposit.

DeviceSummary.description: A device as administrators see it (no secrets).

last_error.description: Why the last onboarding step failed.

DocumentState.description: An invoice's e-invoice as people and the billing engine see it.

qr.description: The QR code (base64 TLV) to print.

validation.description: ZATCA's validation results, as it sent them.

ErrorDetails.description:
`ErrorResponse.details`: its shape depends on the `error` code —
a list of [`FieldError`] on `validation_error`, [`RuleViolationDetails`] on
`rule_violation`, [`FieldLockedDetails`] on `field_locked` and
`field_locked_required` (D-789).

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope. `error` is a stable machine-readable code; `message` is human-readable and never contains internal detail.

current_state.description:
Present on a version conflict: the server's current row for the
fields the caller touched, as a JSON object. The owning engine filters
sensitive columns out before building it (BTY-16c's precondition), so
this is a deliberate filtered projection — never a raw row dump.

current_version.description:
Present on a version conflict: the `row_version` the server currently
holds, so a caller can re-read and retry instead of guessing what the
winner wrote. Omitted when the conflict is not version-based.

oneOf.description:
Structured detail, shaped by `error` (see [`ErrorDetails`]): every
field-level failure on a `validation_error` response when the raiser
has a field list, so a form can render them all at once; every firing
rule on a `rule_violation` response from a business rule; every
refused field on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required`. Omitted
otherwise.

error.description:
Stable machine-readable code — `not_found`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`,
`attribute_not_writable`, `limit_exceeded`,
`conflict`, `version_conflict`, `duplicate_detected`, `idempotency_conflict`,
`validation_error`, `customer_tests_failed`, `feature_unavailable`, `feature_hidden`,
`rate_limit_exceeded`, `overloaded`, `capability_unavailable`,
`metadata_authoring_locked`, `transition_not_allowed`,
`rule_violation`, `field_locked`, `field_locked_required`,
`reauth_required`, `server_timeout`, `query_timeout`, `read_only`, `payload_too_large`,
`request_rejected`, `invalid_cursor`, `resync_needed`, `cascade_restricted`,
`idempotency_outcome_unknown`, `idempotency_replay_unavailable`,
`method_not_allowed`, or
`internal_error` — one per `AppError` variant (`FieldLocked` answers
two: plain and required) (`attome-types/src/error.rs`); M01 Core C-23
found this list four codes short of the taxonomy it documents.

errors.description:
Every field-level failure on a `validation_error`, as
`{attribute, rule, message, fix}`.

field.description:
Present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` (D-789): the first
refused field (every one is in `details.fields`); on
`attribute_not_writable` (Q15-T4): the attribute the caller may not
write.

hidden.description:
Present on `duplicate_detected`: how many more matches the caller may
not read.

instance.description: The request path the problem happened at.

matches.description:
Present on `duplicate_detected` (A15-T4): the existing records the
save matches that the caller may read (record, rule, score).

request_id.description:
Present on responses that passed through the request-id middleware
(D-043); absent on the few pre-middleware rejection paths.

retry_after_sec.description:
Present on a `rate_limit_exceeded` response when the limiter knows its
window: seconds to wait before retrying, equal by construction to the
`Retry-After` header on the same response (BTY-11a). Omitted when the
limit that was hit has no known window.

retryable.description:
Whether the same request may succeed later (the error catalogue's
verdict for `code`).

rule_id.description:
Present on a `rule_violation` response (D-472): the id of the
`xrm_core_rule` whose failing expression produced this 422, so a
client can highlight or re-check the exact rule without parsing
`message`. Omitted on every other code, and on any response that
does not name a rule.
Also present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` (D-789): the
business rule that locks `field`.

rule_name.description:
Present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required`: the display name
of the rule that locks `field`.

title.description:
A short title for `code` in the request's language (Z14-T3), e.g.
`The resource was not found.`

type.description: Z14-T1 (RFC 9457): `about:blank`; the problem is named by `code`.

FieldError.description:
One field-level failure inside `ErrorResponse.details` (BTY-16b): the
field the caller sent, a stable machine-readable `code` the client maps
to localized text (e.g. `required`, `too_long`, `invalid_format`,
`not_allowed`), and the English server-side `message`.

A list, not a single error, so one 422 can answer with every bad field at
once (BTY-F11) instead of making a form discover them one round-trip at a
time.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable failure code for this field, independent of
the message text.

field.description:
The offending field, as the caller addressed it (e.g. `email` or
`amount`).

message.description: Human-readable, English, server-side detail for this field.

FieldLockedDetails.description:
`details` of a `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` response: every
refused field, the first being the one the top-level `field` names.

duplicates.description: Records whose idempotency key was already stored.

InvoiceRequest.description: An invoice another feature asks for.

idempotency_key.description:
Unique per `source_kind`; a repeat with the same key is the same
request.

request_date.description:
The day the charge belongs to (default today); grouped accounts get
one invoice per currency and day.

source_ref.description: The asking record's id or key.

LineAsOf.description: One line as it stood on a date.

quantity.description: `None` when the line had no segment in force that day.

url.description: The link to send the payer; shown once.

LinkRequest.description: What a link is for: an invoice, an order, or an amount for an account.

account_id.description: With `amount` and `currency`: a free amount for this account.

LockedField.description:
One field a business rule locks for the writer (D-789 §3.5): `effect` is
`hidden` or `disabled`. No value is ever echoed.

Movements.description: How the recurring revenue moved between two days, in one currency.

invoice_types.description:
`1100` (standard and simplified, the default), `1000` standard only,
`0100` simplified only.

location.description: Where it is (a short address or national address code).

organization_unit.description: The branch or unit the device invoices for.

NewPayment.description: A payment received outside a gateway (transfer, cheque, cash).

allocations.description: How the payer said to split it; oldest due first when absent.

method.description: One of the payment methods; `bank_transfer` by default.

received_on.description: The day it was received (default today).

NoteCreated.description: The note created (a draft), or, for a cancellation, how its issue went.

otp.description: The one-time password the Fatoora portal shows.

PaginatedResponse_AgeingRow.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

items.description: One account's open amounts in one currency, by days past due.

current.description: Not yet due (and open credit, which is negative).

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_AgeingTotals.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

items.description: The whole book in one currency, by days past due.

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_DeviceSummary.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

items.description: A device as administrators see it (no secrets).

last_error.description: Why the last onboarding step failed.

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_DocumentRef.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

items.description: One document that can answer a dispute.

field.description: The file field to download it from.

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_RunGroup.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

items.description: One invoice request a run would make.

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

unallocated.description: Left over as the customer's credit, decimal text.

ProFormaConverted.description: The new draft a pro forma invoice became.

currencies.description: One set of measures per currency.

created.description: False when this was a repeat of a stored request.

RequestLine.description: One line of an invoice request.

RuleFailure.description:
One business-rule `error` policy that fired (D-789 §3.3), inside a
`rule_violation` body's `details.rules`. Carries names and the rule's own
message, never a record value.

field.description: The field the policy is attached to, when it names one.

rule_name.description: The rule's display name (its name when it has none).

RuleViolationDetails.description:
`details` of a `rule_violation` response (D-789): the field of the first
failing policy, when it names one, and every blocking `error` policy that
fired, the first (by rule display order) being the one `rule_id` names.

amount.description: What it adds to the balance (a payment or credit note is negative).

invoice_id.description: The invoice the line is about.

reference.description:
The document number, the payment's reference, or the write-off's
reason.

SubscriptionAsOf.description: A subscription as it stood on a date.

subscription.description: The record as the caller reads it.

UsageIn.description: One usage record as the sender reports it.

idempotency_key.description: The sender's key for this record; repeating it is harmless.

metric.description: What was used, such as `api_calls` or `storage_gb_hours`.

Warning.description:
Something the server did that the caller should know about though the
request succeeded (a value truncated, a default applied, a page clamped):
a stable `code` and English `message`. Sent only when there is one.

new.description: Of those, new ones (the rest were delivered before).

open_total.description: What is still open after it (unchanged while pending).

portal_session.name: __Secure-wp_{portal}_session
portal_session.description: A web portal user's session cookie, issued by the portal's sign-in; `{portal}` is the portal's keyword (`wp_{portal}_session` on plain-http local dev). Valid only on that portal's own routes.

s2s_hmac.name: x-s2s-signature
s2s_hmac.description: A system-to-system call, signed. Send `x-s2s-client-id`, `x-s2s-key-id`, `x-s2s-timestamp` (Unix milliseconds, within 300 seconds of the server's clock), `x-s2s-nonce` (single use: a repeat is refused) and `x-s2s-signature`: the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed by the hex-decoded client secret, of `METHOD`, `PATH_AND_QUERY`, the hex SHA-256 of the body, `TIMESTAMP` and `NONCE`, joined by newlines in that order.

session_cookie.name: __Host-session_token
session_cookie.description: Browser session cookie issued by POST /api/v1/auth/login. Mutating requests additionally require the CSRF conditions enforced by `middleware::csrf`.
